blogs.title: Stop Sending Queries to LLMs for Every Prediction: Meet FeatLLM
blogs.description: Explore why current LLM-based tabular models are slow and expensive because they predict every single data point individually. Learn how the new FeatLLM framework flips the script by using LLMs solely as feature engineers. Once the rules are extracted, you can use a lightweight model for instant predictions, slashing inference costs while maintaining high accuracy.

blogs.title: From Raw Numbers to Smart Rules: How LLMs Automate Feature Engineering
blogs.description: Discover the secret sauce behind FeatLLM's success in few-shot learning. Instead of just feeding raw numbers into a model, this approach leverages an LLM's vast world knowledge to derive human-readable decision rules (e.g., 'If Age > 60 and Cholesterol > High...'). We break down how these natural language rules are converted into binary features that drive powerful predictions even with very little data.

blogs.title: Crushing Spurious Correlations: Why Few-Shot Tabular Learning Needs Prior Knowledge
blogs.description: Why do standard AI models fail when they see only a handful of examples? Often, they latch onto noise and fake patterns. This post dives into how FeatLLM combats this by forcing the LLM to reason about *causal* relationships before generating features. See how this two-step reasoning process filters out irrelevant columns and builds robust models that resist being tricked by noisy data.
